subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the macOS dependency owners accept these three upstream Swift package versions after the current native validation completes and a resolved-build or application smoke transcript is available?
rationale: This is an upstream compatibility acceptance decision, not a mechanical source repair: the lockfile changes dependencies used by the native app and the supplied material does not prove the resulting graph in a real macOS setup.

options.title: Validate then merge
options.body: Wait for the current macOS jobs and attach redacted package-resolution/build or app-smoke evidence before accepting the updated pins.

options.title: Accept upstream risk
options.body: Merge based on the narrow lockfile update and upstream release metadata, accepting that native compatibility has not been independently demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Validate then merge
recommendation.body: Wait for the current macOS jobs and attach redacted package-resolution/build or app-smoke evidence before accepting the updated pins.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly notified and are the strongest available routing contact for the macOS dependency decision.
